comment: The effect budget (D-523). The light row counts the Godot lights with shadows whose range reaches the worst view of 640 by 360 art pixels (D-842). Each light source is a pair of Godot lights, and the carried light counts too (D-847, D-853). The owner raised the row from the 15 of the sweep of 2026-09-17 to 24, and a new Deck sweep with 24 paired lights proves it before PR-56 merges (D-617, D-854, G-14). The particle row is the 8192 live particles of the sweep of 2026-09-17. One burst of a hit, the weather of a map, and the fire of each torch count against it (D-617, D-875, D-890). The pass row rose from the 3 passes of the sweep of 2026-09-17 to 6: the fog, the glow, the tilt-shift blur, the vignette, the light shafts, and a transition, which the Deck sweep of 2026-09-23 held at 6.67 ms at the 95th percentile, with every row at once (D-922, D-923, F-106, G-14). A fog of 1 to 3 layers counts as one (D-898). The glow, the blur, and the vignette count on every map and every fight, and the shafts count on a map with a shaft (D-915, D-920). Each row is a floor, and not the limit of the Deck (F-66). PR-60 counts its transition against the pass row.
